_about: Which files feed each cue (quality goal B1). Files in Content/Audio/Recorded20261118: <Cue>_<n>.pcm = recorded, <Cue>_g<n>.pcm = generated supplement. Per cue: recorded (only <Cue>_<n>), generated (only <Cue>_g<n>) or mixed (both pools together). A choice with no matching files falls back to the other pool and logs it. Missing file: every cue is mixed (compiled-in default; packaged builds have no Data/). Read at start from the Data/dragon folder.

ambience._about: Mix pass 6 courtyard ambience (tools/audio/prepare_courtyard_ambience.py from tools/audio/freesound_candidates.py public CC0 previews; no account). Content/Audio/Courtyard20261119, 24 kHz mono loops. -VeyrCathedralAmbience restores the old room tone.

Courtyard20261119/Ambience.pcm.use: bed under everything: low wind (high-pass 60 Hz, low-pass 1.2 kHz) plus night insects 12 dB under it, 61 s loop, RMS -24 dBFS

Courtyard20261119/Brazier.pcm.use: fire crackle loop played from each courtyard brazier, 35 s loop, RMS -28 dBFS
